title: ToolInvocationRequested
description: Command dispatched by the orchestrator to trigger a tool worker. Topic: tool-invocation-requests. Producer: orchestrator.ts. Consumer: tool workers (mathApp, weatherApp, exchangeApp, generalChatApp, rag_retriever).

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the conversation (partition key)

toolName.description: Name of the tool to invoke (e.g. math, weather, exchangeRate, generalChat, getProductInformation)

input.description: Resolved arguments passed to the tool (placeholders already substituted)
